requirements.quote: The Manufacturer shall size this unit based on the heat gain of the equipment installed, the environmental conditions and the required operating range.
requirements.text: Manufacturer must size unit considering heat gain, environmental conditions, and operating range.

requirements.quote: The HVAC unit shall be positioned to provide adequate air distribution throughout the switch gear assembly.
requirements.text: HVAC unit must ensure proper air distribution in switch gear assembly.

requirements.quote: Shall be of high conductivity silver-plated copper with adequate current carrying capacity.
requirements.text: Electrical buses must use silver-plated copper with sufficient current capacity.

requirements.quote: Shall have fluidized bed or powder coat epoxy flame-retardant and track-resistant insulation. (Sleeving not allowed).
requirements.text: Buses require flame-retardant epoxy insulation; sleeving is prohibited.

requirements.quote: Circuit breaker primary spouts shall be porcelain.
requirements.text: Primary spouts of circuit breakers must be porcelain.

requirements.quote: Bus shall have provisions for future extension.
requirements.text: Bus design must allow for future extensions.

requirements.quote: The temperature rise of the bus and connections shall be in accordance with ANSI standards and documented by design tests.
requirements.text: Bus temperature rise must meet ANSI standards and be verified by tests.

requirements.quote: Bus joints and tap joints shall be silver plated and tightly bolted with Belleville washers to insure a good connection. Joints shall be insulated with easily installed boots. Provision shall be made and materials supplied to complete the insulation for all joints and taps which must be made in the field to complete the assembly.
requirements.text: Bus joints must be silver-plated, bolted with Belleville washers, insulated with boots, and field assembly provisions provided.

requirements.quote: The main horizontal bus and all vertical buses shall be of non-tapered construction braced to withstand a short circuit rating of 40 kA RMS symmetrical. All buses and taps shall be completely insulated and rated 110 kV BIL.
requirements.text: Buses must be non-tapered, withstand 40 kA RMS, and be insulated to 110 kV BIL.
Main bus must support 2000A continuous current.
Feeder buses must support 1200A continuous current.

requirements.quote: Switchgear structure and base shall be bonded together for grounding. Provide NEMA 2-hold ground pads on exterior base corners of switchgear for tie to substation ground grid.
requirements.text: Switchgear must have bonded structure and base with NEMA ground pads for substation grid connection.

requirements.quote: Equipment grounds: Provide dedicated, pre-drilled, perimeter copper ground bus wall mounted above wireway and switchgear control panels for AC panel, DC panel, battery charger, RTU, and relay panels. Bond all dedicated ground bus with 2/0 soft drawn, green insulated copper.
requirements.text: Provide dedicated copper ground bus for equipment, bonded with green insulated copper.
